sources.title: Bounded planet and sign interpretation modules
excluded_scope: North Node function semantics, which require the separate North Node registry and dedicated typed applicability
automatic promotion of the external repository as project policy authority
sources.derivative_relationship: Reviewed modules combine historical source notes with implementation-authored synthesis; this registry stores only project-authored normalized paraphrases.
notes: The external repository remains REFERENCE-ONLY at repository level; CLAIM_ELIGIBLE here is limited to the reviewed bounded claims and locators.
Exact planet-in-sign pair modules are not promoted wholesale; pair-specific meaning requires separate admission.

lineage_rules: Fact geometry and sign assignment remain owned by the deterministic Astrology provider/runtime.
Planet-function and sign-style claims are composed only after typed fact applicability binding.
A retrieval miss never permits model-memory invention.
North Node semantics are not supplied by this registry; any admitted Node interpretation must use a separate source-backed claim family and dedicated typed applicability.

research_result.architecture_reference: wvanderen/astrology-skill uses planet modules plus sign modules with sparse exact-placement modules; immanuel-python and tri-horoscope keep chart facts structurally separate from interpretation.

selection_policy.rationale: The reviewed source is a modern/blended reference implementation; broad modern/blended tags are not canonical doctrine selectors.
